name: Stock by book stands over the cards
replace: + '<section id="nStock" class="amb-stack nstock" aria-label="Stock by book" hidden></section><div class="amb-split nsplit"><div class="amb-stack">

name: the least cover first, whatever the light
the light in one tone
a book with no light says Available
the book is plain words
the meter never fills past the shelf
the meter is never ember
four weeks of cover says over 4 wk
a day with nothing coming says nothing
a figure under nought keeps a hyphen
Next lot shares the cover's cell
the table does not stack
the cells carry no labels
find: var td=el('td',cls,text); td.setAttribute('data-label',label); tr.appendChild(td); return td;

name: a free figure under nought is not ember
the table has no meter
find: var mc=cell('Of shelf'), m=el('progress','amb-meter'); m.max=100; m.value=r.fill; m.setAttribute('aria-label','Agreed '+r.agreed+' of '+r.shelf); mc.appendChild(m);

name: the stack table keeps its head on a phone
the meter has no width
a tick does not read the stock
a failed tick clears the rows
no books keeps the old rows
